english.meaning: to act as if one is better or more popular than one is
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: You act like you’ve got lots of girlfriends.
exampleSentences.traditional: 讕係以為自己好多女朋友𡃉喎。
